title: TRACE Registry Entry
description: One line of a registry/YYYY/MM/DD.ndjson file. See docs/anchor-format.md and docs/checkpoint-architecture.md.

ts.description: Anchoring time, ISO-8601 UTC with Z suffix

leaf_count.description: Total number of claims (leaves) covered by this entry

producer.description: Identifier of the party that anchored this entry, in the form name/semver

batch_id.description: Unique identifier for this entry scoped to the producer

entry_type.description: Entry type. Omit for batch (default). 'checkpoint' covers multiple batches (see docs/checkpoint-architecture.md).

batch_count.description: Checkpoint only: number of batch Merkle roots included in this checkpoint tree

first_batch_ts.description: Checkpoint only: timestamp of the earliest batch covered

last_batch_ts.description: Checkpoint only: timestamp of the latest batch covered

canonicalization_id.description: Batch entries only: the CPB anchor-leaf construction this entry's leaves were built under (docs/anchor-format.md section 0). Both are first-class and permanently valid; neither is a fallback for the other. Omitted on entries anchored before this field existed -- those were all built under sorted-key, the only construction that existed at the time; a verifier MUST infer sorted-key for an absent field, never as-transmitted.

mmr_checkpoint.description: CLL (Checkpointed Local Log, draft-mih-scitt-checkpointed-local-log) signed checkpoint over the aggregator-wide append-only MMR of all registry entries. Additive to (not a replacement for) this entry's own batch merkle_root: the batch proof still proves one claim is in this entry; this proves this entry's anchoring run honestly extends the previous one. See docs/mmr-checkpoint.md. Unrelated to entry_type='checkpoint' (docs/checkpoint-architecture.md's separate, not-yet-implemented two-level batch-of-batches design) -- both may exist in this registry without conflict.

log_id.description: Identifies the append-only MMR log this checkpoint belongs to (one per aggregator deployment today).

mmr_size.description: MMR node count (not leaf count) as of this checkpoint.

root.description: Bagged-peaks MMR root at mmr_size, hex-encoded (32 bytes).

prev_size.description: mmr_size of the previous checkpoint in this log; 0 for the first checkpoint.

prev_root.description: root of the previous checkpoint; empty string for the first checkpoint.

key_id.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded -- self-contained, no external key registry lookup needed to verify signature.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the checkpoint signing body.

consistency_proof.description: MMR consistency (extension) proof tying this checkpoint's root back to prev_root by math, not by field equality. Required on every checkpoint except the first (prev_size=0).
